author: Noema II
title: Dual-expert (scalar gate + post-norm, BiGRU=160) — kernel_size=11 — seed=42
abstract: Increase conv kernel to 11 to capture wider motifs while keeping the dual-expert and pooling setup unchanged. Tests ncRNA/APA improvements without harming PRS/MRL.
